shared_elements: a large worked monolithic block/slab as the object itself
low-relief carving on a broad stone face
justification: Both are massive shaped stone blocks bearing shallow relief on a broad face, but that is a generic correspondence: B shows a clearly readable quadruped in relief descending head-down along a T-shaped pillar's shaft, while A shows only vague curved/concentric bosses on an otherwise unarticulated rough boulder with no identifiable creature, figure or ordered motif. The absence of any comparable figural subject or arrangement in A means the resemblance rests almost entirely on both being monoliths, which counts for little iconographically.
